title: Expedition X
description:

Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate Vulture City, Ariz., a ghost town with Gold Rush-era spirits; they explore possible ancient, darker forces.

title: Expedition X
description:

Heather and Phil travel to the French countryside to track down werewolves that have terrorized the locals for centuries; as their investigation deepens, they must figure out if this beast is supernatural or an elusive wolf undiscovered by man.

title: Expedition X
description:
S12 E04 — Ghosts of Guam
Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E03 — Blackbeard's Ghost
Heather and Phil explore Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering; is the pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

description:
S09 E03 — Man Overboard
Dustin's crew inches closer to a monster payday; on a resupply mission to civilization, Wes goes missing after a life-threatening fall from the airboat into the raging 36°F river and the crew fears the worst.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S09 E04 — Fight for Your Life
Mine boss Dustin Hurt mounts an emergency rescue mission on the Tsirku river; his crippling debts and lack of gold force him to push his exhausted crew to their limit, causing a fight that threatens to end Carlos' time at Nugget Creek.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E02 — The Tunnel of Chaos
The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E08 — Wait, That's Factory?
As people spend more time in cars, drivers crave the comforts of home; factory options like glove-box cocktail bars promise just that, though not all are created equal; join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options!

title: The RVers
description:
S07 E03 — Anne and Mel & Rick and Mindy
Former RV park managers open their home up to transient travelers.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E02 — A Midas Mess
Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E03 — Diagnosing Rick
Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S16 E03 — The Great Gold Rush Shootout
Gold Rush's Parker Schnabel joins Josh Gates to investigate an infamous California stagecoach robbery gone bad; fighting a driving rainstorm, Josh leans on Parker's gold mining expertise to close in on the $10M lost treasure.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E03 — The Lost Grave of Buffalo Bill
Josh saddles up to investigate a scandal over the remains of Wild West legend Buffalo Bill Cody; a first-hand account claims Bill's body was stolen and buried 500 miles away; with new leads, Josh digs for the cowboy's grave and the truth.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S15 E06 — Searching for World War II's Lost Hero
Armed with a new eyewitness account and cutting-edge tech, Josh travels to Micronesia and dives the Pacific to find a lost P-47 Thunderbolt; piloted by an American hero, the plane took part in a daring raid during the final days of World War II.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E01 — Hunt for World War II Hellships
Josh searches for more than 1,000 POWs lost in the Pacific Theater; he dives to find lost Allied soldiers on the Hofuku Maru, a notorious Japanese Hellship.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E02 — Finding World War II's Lost Prisoners
A deep-water dive leads to the discovery of a lost WWII hell ship, where an estimated 1,000 soldiers made the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E07 — Inca Treasure Tunnels
Josh helps discover and explore a labyrinth of lost tunnels; he dodges traffic to assist in a first-ever radar scan below the busy streets of Cuzco, Peru; he joins them as they push into the tunnels and find priceless ancient treasures.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E08 — Clash of the Survivalists
Forced to trek two days to a water source, a laid-back hunter and an opinionated adventurer clash in Zambia, risking their 21-day challenge; as danger mounts, their trust cracks.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E04 — Predatorland
An unlikely duo, a hairdresser and a former correctional officer, must survive 14 days in Zambia, home to some of Africa's most dangerous wildlife; with predators all around and a herd of aggressive elephants closing in, their survival is threatened.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E07 — Savage Paradise
A tropical paradise turns savage when two superfans battle pounding monsoon rains, poisonous fruit and biting rats as they try to survive 14 days on a remote Thai island.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E01 — Flesh and Fangs
Legend Matt Wright crashes into two survivalists in Florida's Everglades, where intense heat, severe storms and aggressive crocs threaten to take everyone out of the challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E11 — Ranger in Danger
A South African ranger and a Texan wilderness guide set out to prove they can survive 21 days in a remote Thai jungle, where relentless monsoons, failed traps, and a face-off with a king cobra drive them to the edge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E09 — Hell in the Highlands
Haunted by their previous tap-outs, two survivalists seek redemption in Thailand's steep highland jungle; relentless monsoon rains, lack of fire and the threat of trench foot threaten to end their 21 days early once again.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E02 — F*cking Broncos
Pop's returning customer from Texas wants a Ford Bronco converted into a pickup truck that can tow a 7,000-pound boat and is still fit for off-roading; Jerry Jr. orders the shop to paint a truck in a vivid neon green to chase likes and shares online.

title: Mud Madness
description:
S02 E01 — Mud, Mayhem, and Glory
Step into the adrenaline-fueled world of off-road mud racing in the first-ever Mud Cup Invitational!; 10 fearless drivers face off in a thrilling eight-race showdown across four states $100,000 in prizes are at stake, and it's anyone's race.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E19 — Myth Revolution
Kari, Tory and Grant put a radio-frequency identification conspiracy theory to the test; Adam and Jamie test two myths about weapons.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E27 — Lead Balloon
The team tests if dynamite can create ideal surfing conditions and then tests the proverbial lead balloon.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E04 — Underwater Car
Adam and Jamie try to escape a car submerged in water.

title: MythBusters
description:
S16 E02 — Household Disasters
Testing household myths; exploding a vacuum cleaner with black powder; sunscreen scorching skin; piano through a roof; exploding water heater extinguishing fire.

title: MythBusters
description:
S05 E31 — MacGyver Myths
A tribute to "MacGyver;" the team makes an explosive with a gram of sodium and water; they build an ultralight airplane with bamboo, a stolen engine and duct tape.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E09 — Florida Man
Florida is full of tales of Florida Man and now his antics are caught on tape; whether he's stealing gators or eating cheesecake naked in the swamp, the unpredictable creature is captured in his natural habitat.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E15 — Nude, Crude, and Unscrewed
Being naked in public is about as bold a choice as one can make, but there's something special about these free and fearless frolickers. Raunchy rule-breakers demonstrate how breaking societal norms and laws can put one in a pickle.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E20 — Stunts Gone Wrong
People take advantage of every element, especially fire, water, ice, and air, when performing dangerous stunts and concocting crazy contraptions.

title: Caught!
description:
Man vs. Machine
Unveiling the uproarious clash between humans and machines; from power tools to semi-trucks, each moment is a lighthearted adventure in the whimsical battle of man vs. machine.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E06 — DIY Disasters
Many people between the ages of 25 and 45 who get caught in chainsaw mishaps, beehive blunders and more, learn why it's best to leave it to the pros.

title: Caught!
description:
Go Big or Go Home
A hilarious rollercoaster of laughs; action-packed clips filled with big thrills, spills, and countless surprises.

title: Caught!
description:
Work Hard and Play Harder
Humorous, insightful scenarios abound across diverse landscapes; witnessing firsthand the quirky side of American life; exploring unexpectedly uproarious outcomes of hard work and determination.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E08 — Shocking Stunts
Throughout history, thrill-seekers have dared to perform outrageous stunts and jeopardize their safety for glory; in modern times, it is internet virality that drives such individuals.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E08 — Weekend Warriors
After a seemingly endless work week, millions of people blow off steam on the weekend -- and that's when things get wild; from day drinking to house parties and late-night dinners, the big fight weekend kicks off the chaos.

title: Caught!
description:
Licensed to Thrill
This week's comedy clips push boundaries and guarantee thrills -- no license is required, but buckle up for the ride.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E08 — ... And a Bag of Chips
A man entering the U.S. with more cash than the $10,000 limit raises eyebrows; officers find a cooler full of rat meat in the back of a traveler's vehicle, but further inspection uncovers something more surprising.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
No Gun Intended
Drug cartels are estimated to control up to one-third of Mexico's territory — there's an insatiable demand for guns and ammo south of the border, and a ready supply of Americans willing to smuggle them. CBP is ready to intercept.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
You Put That Where?
As they pursue profit, drug cartels are constantly adapting -- hiding deadly narcotics where few would ever expect to find them.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E01 — Fight Club
After the murder of 15-year-old Milli Penn, Grand Rapids detectives investigate the masked shooter, rumored to be another teenager linked to a fight club; then, another shooting strikes and detectives must solve the case before more lives are lost.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E03 — A King-Size Bust
A mother and daughter are caught under the influence of meth; a million-dollar load is found within a shipment of mattresses; a young traveler attempts to smuggle pills in his waistband; officers apprehend a man with an outstanding warrant.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E01 — Lime and Punishment
A man crosses with something that fell from the sky, literally, as well as the remains of a federally protected animal; officers find a stay-at-home mom who may have a side hustle dealing pills and a shipment of limes arrives with an extra surprise.

S17 E01 — Captains of Industry
As a new Industrial Revolution sweeps Nome, the miners elevate their operations; a cracked spud may mean disaster for Shawn; Kris Kelly struggles with faulty equipment; Chris McCully has a blockbuster start, while Vernon buys an unorthodox dredge.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush

Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

title: Gold Rush

Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S06 E07 — Troubled Water
The Raneys help a couple with a toxic salt water well, making it impossible for them to maintain a food source or livestock; Marty needs clay to build a massive catchment pond; Matt must build a large-scale solar still to decontaminate the water.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E04 — Bee Stings and Better Days
In NM, parents fear for a son battling Lyme; the Raneys discover he's turned to bee sting therapy, a plan that unravels when his homestead's hive vanishes; they face a brutal choice as stress worsens his condition: push on or risk permanent damage.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E02 — A Homestead Divided
On a mesa in Arizona, the Raneys step into a homestead and marriage under strain; to secure the family's future, they must pull an ambitious husband away from his years-long, unfinished passion project, and force a hard reset before total collapse.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E01 — Sin City, Alabama
Mark, Digger and Tim uncover a moonshine-soaked conspiracy in Phenix City, Ala., where corrupt power brokers prey on young soldiers; when one man dares to fight back, his back-alley murder sparks a reckoning that would finally break the mob's grip.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E02 — Brooklyn Whiskey Wars
Mark, Digger and Tim probe Brooklyn's Civil War-era liquor tax battles; they examine how government use of Marines to enforce taxes led to clashes with urban moonshiners, establishing a pattern of conflict between tax collectors and distillers.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E09 — Cold Hard Crash-Out
A massive seven-acre, snow-covered hoard pushes Matt to the brink; when it takes the team a full day just to unclog the driveway, Matt's deep in the red.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E10 — Gunning for Ghost Town Green
Matt is shocked when clients reveal a Pioneer Village that's become a ghost town after three decades of abandonment; Matt hunts for a rare Colt prototype and a Babe Ruth autograph rumored to be on a hot dog wrapper.

description:
S01 E03 — Curse of the Kraken
Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E01 — The Bermuda Triangle Conspiracy
Jeremy Wade investigates if one of the Bermuda Triangle's most infamous disappearances is a part of a conspiracy by a secret agent at war with the United States; using technology, experts reveal if it vanished for far stranger reasons.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S01 E04 — Black Hills Ordinance Depot
A sprawling military facility dotted with bunkers for miles now stands abandoned in the American heartland of Edgemont, S.D.; experts investigate and uncover a once highly-secure WWII ordnance site designed to store deadly munitions.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S01 E03 — Remains of the Super Guppy
A monstrous airplane that helped America reach new, historic heights sits decommissioned in Tucson, Ariz.; experts investigate and reveal one of the most important aircraft of the 20th century and its contribution to the Apollo spaceflight program.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
Rebirth of Amboy
A derelict ghost town shows a curious revitalization along an iconic highway in the Mojave Desert; experts investigate and reveal a once thriving and bustling Route 66 stopover that's being resurrected into a historic Americana destination.
